mapper.update: INSERT INTO procurement (merge_key, date_of_order, title, amount, government_departments, note) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{dateOfOrder}, #{title}, #{amount}, #{governmentDepartments}, #{note}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO company_procurement (company_id, procurement_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{procurementId}, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid) ON CONFLICT (company_id, procurement_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE company_procurement SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE deleted = false AND company_id = #{companyId}
UPDATE company_procurement SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE deleted = false AND company_id = #{companyId} AND sync_id != #{syncId}::uuid
